# xtma/rlpyt (vendored, unmodified subset)

The modules APO's update and rlpyt's `MujocoFfAgent` import (`rlpyt/agents`,
`algos`, `distributions`, `models`, `samplers/collections.py`, `utils`; the
39 a recording loads) are copied unchanged from
[xtma/rlpyt](https://github.com/xtma/rlpyt) at commit `e28bb20`, the APO
authors' fork of [rlpyt](https://github.com/astooke/rlpyt). MIT License, see
`LICENSE`.
